description: Mismatched helmet-to-backpack air vent diameters were found across the suit inventory — not all combinations are compatible.
response: Engineers tested each combination to map compatibility before the first EVA.
lesson: Maintain and distribute a compatibility matrix of all suit, helmet, and backpack sets. Confirm with the Mars Society before departure.
